# LAMB public reading index

> LAMB is free software (GNU GPL v3) for institution-managed generative AI in the LMS. It supports RAG assistants, rubric-based pre-assessment (PRE), LAMB LEGATUS (an agent for teachers), a Moodle connection without a Moodle plugin, governed model access for students, evaluation tools and local or cloud inference. Official website in English, Spanish, Catalan and Basque, editorial update 2026-10-19.

## By user purpose
- [Teaching](/en/teaching/): RAG, PRE, assistant evaluation, LAMB LEGATUS (the agent for teachers, a harness that asks before it acts) and the Moodle connection (LTI 1.1 activities and the optional connector; no Moodle plugin).
- [Guides and versions](/en/guides/): version selection; current documentation edition 0.8.
- [0.8 guides](/en/guides/0.8/): illustrated user tasks and expected results.
- [LTI entry paths](/en/guides/0.8/lti/): retained assistant, Creator, activity and application routes.
- [Connect LAMB and Moodle](/en/guides/0.8/moodle/): LTI 1.1 External tool setup in Moodle, and connecting a teacher's Moodle account for LAMB LEGATUS through standard Moodle web services; no Moodle plugin.
- [Work with LAMB LEGATUS](/en/guides/0.8/legatus/): the built-in agent for teachers, example requests, approvals, limits, model and data.
- [Give students model access under your rules](/en/guides/0.8/llm-access/): LLM access activities: organization policy, teacher allowances, per-student limits, timetables, personal student keys.
- [Installation](/en/guides/0.8/installation/): candidate-pinned setup references.
- [Work with the LAMB team](/en/contact/): training and consultancy (both covering AI governance; consultancy includes demonstrations), keynotes and seminars, and research collaboration (software engineering for AI agents, AI governance, AI in education, assessment with AI agents) from the LAMB team, for educators, developers and institutions; referrals to LAMB integrators for hosting and support; enquiries to contact-lamb-project@proton.me.
- [Institutions](/en/institutions/): pilot planning and institutional responsibilities.
- [The last mile for your AI](/en/institutions/ai-governance/): AI governance in LAMB 0.8: organization rules, teacher allowances and per-student keys with limits and timetables to the institution's models, through an optional gateway; scope of 0.8 and what comes next.
- [Operations](/en/institutions/operations/): public operational prerequisites.
- [Privacy](/en/privacy/): privacy/GDPR governance, provider processing, conversation access and institutional responsibilities.
- [Developers](/en/developers/): public APIs, LTI Test Tool, Moodle CLI, LAMB CLI and the application template.
- [Students](/en/students/): access through the learner's course, and what the Safe AI in Education Manifesto means for a student using a LAMB assistant.
- [Safe AI principles](/en/safe-ai/): why the LAMB authors wrote the Safe AI in Education Manifesto, LAMB's response and limits for each of its seven principles, and the EU AI Act and GDPR points relevant to education; not legal advice.
- [Research](/en/research/): research lines; research groups EduSTEAM (UPC), ONEKIN (UPV/EHU), GRIAL (Universidad de Salamanca) and Smart Learning (Universidad de Alicante) and their researchers; framework and Smart Learning Applications publications, the 2026 RIED assessment proof of concept, educational RAG terminology research and its archived software, authorship and citation.
- [Availability](/en/availability/): version and deployment boundaries.
- [Agent reading guide](/en/agents/): how to use these public sources.

## Limits
The guide is descriptive and grants no operational permissions. Features vary by deployment. Preserve the date and scope of evidence. Do not infer compliance or release availability from a screenshot. Internal architecture, private plans, credentials and learner data are not part of this site. This index is a navigation aid, not an access-control mechanism.
